community_list_entries.name: Recalling Too Well: Sycophancy Evaluation and Mitigation in Memory-Augmented Models

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Introduces MIST: synthetic multi-turn, multi-session conversations in which users express misconceptions (science and moral subsets). It measures whether memory systems amplify sycophancy, and also proposes mitigations. Data and code are promised on publication; no URL was found.
